profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Zoox
profile.summary:
Product focused and user driven Software Engineer currently working on advancing the Mobile Workplace.

I am an innovative and curious software engineer currently working in the Internet of Things (IoT) space. I am interested in design, development, strategy, and business, especially how they all work together. Besides being detail oriented, I love looking at the bigger picture and understanding how the pieces fit together. I am interested in all things related to high tech, networking, and many things in-between.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineering role in the Internet of Things (IoT) field working on powering the next generation of smart spaces through Wi-Fi, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), and Zigbee.

Job Details:
- Designed next generation IoT cloud based architecture
- Redesigned data ingestion parser to reduce system load and memory usage
- Designed external APIs to allow customers to securely interact with their IoT devices
- Designed and implemented build systems to simplify development for fellow team members
- Led projects for large customer integrations
- Designed and implemented features running on Aruba Networks Access Points, including the next generation Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) Access Points.
- Embedded development on Nordic nRF52840 Next Gen Bluetooth 5 platform

Leadership Positions:
- Aruba Site Leadership Council 
- Current president of Hewlett Packard Enterprise Bay Area Young Employee Network (YEN)
- Aruba Intern Coordinator
- Aruba Global Hackathon Organizer

company.name: Aruba, a Hewlett Packard Enterprise company

positions.title: Pre-Silicon ASIC Verification Engineer (Summer Intern)
positions.description:
• Worked as part of the pre-silicon application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC) verification team
• Formal verification in SystemVerilog using JasperGold program by Cadence Design Systems
• Closely worked with and supported design team to verify and troubleshoot design of next generation ASIC architecture
• Wrote and maintained scripts to support pre-silicon environment

positions.title: Post-Silicon ASIC Verification Engineer (Summer Intern)
positions.description:
• Worked as part of the ASIC verification team testing a prototype networking chip, focusing on the Forwarding Engine
• Writing and testing self-contained TCL scripts for new API to use for bring-up of new chip and incorporated it into the Post-Silicon test environment.
• Fixed/Updated the Forwarding Engine environment for new chip
• Assisted Pre-Silicon engineers on getting ASIC Translator to work with new chip generation

positions.title: Lead Lifeguard
positions.description:
• Earned promotion to lead position in recognition of dedication to the organization, positive attitude, and trustworthiness in high pressure situations
• Manage groups of staff and oversee the safety of anyone in or around the aquatic facility

volunteerExperiences.description:
http://rivierayouthbiketeam.org/

The Riviera Youth Bike Team (aka RYBT or “Ribbit“) creates a positive impact on the health and fitness of ‘at-risk’ 10-13 year old children by developing and fostering a connection to cycling. RYBT caters to kids struggling with issues such as obesity, low self-esteem, bullying, and learning differences. The goal is to give children the tools they need to reach and maintain their health and fitness goals in a fun, organized, and supportive team environment, while learning about long-term resources in various cycling communities. RYBT provides programs engaging participants to health professionals, cycling coaches, cycling clubs and communities

projects.title: Senior Design Capstone Project: Solar-powered powered Wi-Fi enabled infrared security camera for FLIR
projects.description:
•	Interdisciplinary team of 13 consisting of Computer Engineers, Electrical Engineers, and Mechanical Engineers.
•	Reliable security camera that is completely self-contained, allowing for easy installation
•	Combination of visual and infrared cameras to complement each other and allow 24/7 monitoring
•	Solar and battery powered to allow for 24/7 uptime, with 100% reliability
•	Worked on embedded systems programming, Android app development, and structural design with Mechanical Engineers

organizations.name: UCSB Cycling
organizations.description: UCSB Cycling is a coed student organization of UCSB Recreational Sports. Our club is composed of recreational and competitive, undergraduate and graduate, students. Our team is part of the Western Collegiate Cycling Conference, a division of USA Cycling. Our competitive collegiate season runs from fall to spring quarter, but we also enjoy racing during the summer.
